prompt: Set up logging for the new payment service. What should I use?
output:
Your team already decided on **structured logging with correlation IDs** across all services (see `decisions.md`). Match that pattern — use the standard JVM stack for Kotlin:

**SLF4J + Logback + `logstash-logback-encoder`** (JSON structured output for EKS/CloudWatch)

`build.gradle.kts`:
```kotlin
implementation("net.logstash.logback:logstash-logback-encoder:7.4")
// SLF4J + Logback come transitively via spring-boot-starter-logging
```

`logback-spring.xml`:
```xml
<configuration>
  <appender name="JSON" class="ch.qos.logback.core.ConsoleAppender">
    <encoder class="net.logstash.logback.encoder.LogstashEncoder"/>
  </appender>
  <root level="INFO">
    <appender-ref ref="JSON"/>
  </root>
</configuration>
```

Correlation ID via MDC (consistent with other services):
```kotlin
// In a gRPC interceptor or HTTP filter
MDC.put("correlationId", request.header("X-Correlation-ID") ?: UUID.randomUUID().toString())

// In service code
private val log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(PaymentService::class.java)
log.info("Processing payment", kv("paymentId", id), kv("amount", amount))
```

The `kv()` helper comes from `logstash-logback-encoder` and emits proper JSON fields (not string concatenation).

This matches what `auth-service`, `account-service`, and `notification-service` already do — no new infra, no new patterns.
